question: Who among the following was the first recipient of the State annual award Nishagandhi Puraskaram from the Government of Kerala in 2013?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mrinalini Sarabhai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prominent **Kathakali **classical dancer** Mrinalini Sarabhai** was awarded the maiden '**Nishagandhi Puraskaram**' of **Kerala **Tourism.
 
• The annual award, containing a purse of Rs. 1.5 lakh, citation and statuette, is to honour eminent personalities in the fields of dance and music.
 
• She was educated at **Shantiniketan **under the supervision of **Rabindranath Tagore.**
 
• She was honoured with P**adma Bhushan in 1992** and **Padma Shri in 1965**.
 
• She also received the **Kerala Sangeetha Nataka Akademi Fellowship in 1988**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
